messages:
jonathan: Heads up — saw a weird kernel choice in prod for seq_len ~512 on A100s during the 21:00 batch. Telemetry shows we picked 'matmul_opt_v2' even though end-to-end p50 was higher than matmul_tiled. Can someone look? logs excerpt below.

jonathan: ```
PICK_DECISION ts=1976543209 model=redwood-7b seq=512 arch=A100 kernel=matmul_opt_v2 reason="cost+cache_est" cost_ms=2.3 alt_kernel=matmul_tiled est_cost_ms=1.9 flags="RW_RUNTIME_PICK_DEBUG=1,RW_SELECT_POLICY=arch_seqlen" kv_hit_rate=0.12 batch_size=8 autotune_version=2026-02-14
KV_SUMMARY last_sample_ts=1976541200 kv_decay=0.6
```

priya: Hmm — that reason string suggests the estimator leans on kv stats. Are those kv metrics up to date? If kv_hit_rate is stale the selector can bias toward bigger matmuls that assume cache warm. Could be a decay-window bug.

maria: I hit this in canary yesterday. Autotuner merged seqlen bins incorrectly for 257-768 (they collapsed into a single bucket). PR #2145 has a fix for the bin edge logic. Likely causes wrong profile selection around 512.

jonathan: PR link? Also the trace_id inside the request showed pick_reason_trace; enabling RW_RUNTIME_PICK_DEBUG=trace prints full heuristics for inspection.

infra-bot: perf-dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/bench/summary?run=19765 — shows a spike in p50 for matmul_opt_v2 at seq512 across pool-a100-2. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

bench-bot: Quick repro command: `perf/run_repro.sh --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --arch a100 --repeat 100` then `jq .picks results.json | grep matmul` to tally picks. In my run matmul_opt_v2 was picked 78/100.

priya: Short-term mitigation: set env RW_SELECT_OVERRIDE=matmul_tiled on pool-a100-2 for the affected lane until autotuner fix lands. That overrides selection and is cheap to apply.

maria: I'll open the patch and add a unit test for seqlen bin boundaries + a telemetry field for pick_version and kv_sample_ts so we can see staleness in the UI. Also adding a gate to block auto-merges of bin changes without perf regression checks.

jonathan: Sweet. I'll enable RW_RUNTIME_PICK_DEBUG=trace and RW_SELECT_POLICY=arch_seqlen in canary and post collected traces here in 30m. If anyone else sees odd picks please paste the PICK_DECISION line (ts, model, seq, arch, kernel, reason, flags). :thumbsup:

priya: FYI: after forcing override we should monitor throughput impact, batching heuristics may shift. Watch batching metrics: batch_size_hist and batch_wait_ms.

jonathan: Ack — watching now. Will follow up with a short summary and a link to the picked-trace bundle.

maria: ETA for patch review ~1h. If stable we'll roll to canary and then prod.

jonathan: Thanks all, appreciate the quick triage.
